Production guide · 22 September 2026

Scenario 1

I already have an SR

Use the products already in Squad.

  1. Step 1
    Open Squad → Requests. Open the correct SR, then its Products area.
  2. Step 2
    Find Work in Google Sheets. Click Review in Google Sheet.
  3. Step 3
    Wait for Workbook ready. Click Open Google Sheet. If that link is already there, use it.

You’re done when: your linked sheet opens. Continue with Scenario 3.

Got a supplier file instead? If this SR has no workbook yet, use Upload vendor documents here. Wait for Workbook ready, then open it. An existing workbook cannot take another upload from this panel.

↑ Choose another task
Scenario 2

I have a supplier price list

Create a new SR from a file.

  1. Step 1
    In Squad, open the new-request page. Click Upload vendor documents and choose the supplier’s file.
  2. Step 2
    Wait for extraction. Open Review extracted rows and anomalies; compare names, quantities, prices and currencies with the file.
  3. Step 3
    Choose the customer, contact, delivery address and owner. Complete any fields listed beside Create SR, then click it.
  4. Step 4
    Open the created SR. Wait for Workbook ready → Open Google Sheet. Correct product details in the sheet.

Files: PDF, images, CSV, TXT or XLSX. Up to 5 files; 10 MB each; 25 MB combined.

You’re done when: the new SR has a linked sheet. Continue with Scenario 3.

This upload path does not start automatic sourcing or supplier messages.

Scenario 3

I want to edit and choose products

Your everyday workspace is the Products tab.

  1. Step 1
    Check Product name, Notes / selling points, Quantity, Supplier unit price and Supplier currency.
  2. Step 2
    Enter numbers only: quantity 100, price 10, currency USD. The price is for one unit.
  3. Step 3
    Scroll right to Packing basis. Choose Single or Carton; fill the matching measurements below when delivery needs them.
  4. Step 4
    Tick Add to quote for wanted products. Untick unwanted products; keep their rows.
SingleProduct dimensions (cm)
+ Single weight (kg)
OR
CartonCarton dimensions (cm)
+ Carton weight (kg)
+ Pieces per carton

Dimensions: 40 × 30 × 20 means length × width × height, in centimetres. Fill the chosen packing basis, not both.

You’re done when: the correct products are ticked. Set pricing in Scenario 4.

↑ Choose another task
Scenario 4

I want to change the customer price

Use the green cells under Quote pricing. Scroll right to find them.

  1. Step 1
    Choose Quote currency: the currency the customer will pay in.
  2. Step 2
    Set Product markup (%). This applies across the sheet.
  3. Step 3
    Enter Tax, Additional fees and Additional discount as amounts—not percentages. Use 0 when none apply.
  4. Step 4
    Check Customer total. Return to Squad and click Update from Google Sheet; recheck the refreshed total.

Exclude delivery: tick only for a products-only quote with no delivery charges. Shipping method and destination are reviewed in Squad.

Simple exampleUSD 10 + 20% markup = USD 12 per unit.
100 units → USD 1,200Assumes no delivery, extra costs, tax or discounts. Markup is not profit margin.

You’re done when: the updated total is correct. Next, check Ready.

Changing customer currency does not change the supplier’s currency. Recheck tax, fees and discount amounts after changing currency. Leave calculated prices and conversion rates alone.

Scenario 5

A product says “Needs attention”

Read the message beside that product.

  1. Step 1
    Find the row’s Review errors. Fill or correct exactly what it asks for.
  2. Step 2
    Return to Squad → Update from Google Sheet. Return to the sheet and check again.
  3. Step 3
    Repeat until every ticked product says Ready. If asked to explain a specification difference, open that product’s review in Squad.
DraftNot selected for the quote.
Needs attentionFix the listed fields.
ReadySelected row passed checks.

Changes normally update automatically after a short wait. The button checks them now. You do not need a second product-by-product validation for Ready sheet rows.

You’re done when: all ticked rows are Ready. Follow Scenario 7.

Scenario 6

I need a sample quotation

Optional: use sample prices and sample quantities.

  1. Step 1
    In the Products sheet, fill Sample fee, Sample currency and Sample details for the wanted products.
  2. Step 2
    Tick those products. In Squad, click Update from Google Sheet, then in the SR’s Products area set Quotation stage → Sample.
  3. Step 3
    Click Create quotation. In Sample details, set Sample quantity (pieces) and review sample terms and packing.
  4. Step 4
    Update from the sheet again. Review the sample prices and totals, then follow Scenario 7.

Important: the sheet’s normal Quantity column is not the sample quantity. Set sample quantity in Squad. A sample fee is not automatically added to a bulk quote.

You’re done when: the preview shows the correct sample quantities and prices.

↑ Choose another task
Scenario 7

I’m ready to create the quotation

Finish in Squad, after the sheet is checked.

  1. Step 1
    Click Update from Google Sheet. Resolve any errors; confirm all ticked rows are Ready.
  2. Step 2
    Click Create quotation on the SR. Check the quotation type and intended products.
  3. Step 3
    Review Shipping → Margins → Terms → Customer preview. Check customer, quantities, currency, delivery and final total.
  4. Step 4
    When approved, click Publish quotation → Publish without sending → confirm Publish quotation. Download or send through your usual process.

You’re done when: the published quotation matches your reviewed numbers.

Publishing does not automatically send the quote in the current production release. If you change the sheet again, update and recheck before publishing.

↑ Choose another task
Scenario 8

My sheet has the older layout

Only if you see Enable pricing in Google Sheet.

  1. Step 1
    In Squad, click Refresh sheet changes, then Sync sheet changes. Resolve any errors first.
  2. Step 2
    Click Enable pricing in Google Sheet. Wait for the new workbook.
  3. Step 3
    Use Open Google Sheet from Squad. Work in this new linked sheet; keep the old one as a reference.

You’re done when: the new sheet has Products, green pricing cells and review status. Follow Scenario 3.

Keep beside you

Stuck? Start here.

What you seeWhat to do
Google says “No access”Use your work Google account. Ask the team admin for access.
Your edits have not appearedWait for Google to save. Return to Squad → Update from Google Sheet.
A product is missingTick Add to quote. Update and check that the row says Ready.
A price is blank or shows an errorCheck supplier price and currency. Update from the sheet to refresh rates; recheck the total.
The total changed after updatingReview the refreshed delivery, rates and fees before creating the quote.
Both Squad and Sheets changedAgree the correct value with your teammate. Stop editing from two places, then reconcile and update.
Upload failedRead the message. Use Retry saved intake. If submission already started, check Requests before creating again.

Three things to leave alone

  1. 1
    Rows and column headings. Untick unused products. Do not paste new rows or delete existing ones.
  2. 2
    Calculated prices, rates and protected cells. Change supplier inputs and green pricing cells instead.
  3. 3
    The linked workbook. Always open it from Squad. A separate copy will not update your SR.

Still stuck? Send your team admin the SR number and a screenshot of the error.
